subject: Pricing follow-up & stakeholder alignment — token volumes & budget (Acme AI)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing follow-up & stakeholder alignment — token volumes & budget (Acme AI)

Hi Alex,

Great to meet today — thanks for walking through Acme's pilot goals and the expected usage patterns. Per our conversation, I wanted to recap the key items and next steps so we can align on economics and the approval path.

Summary from the call:
- Target workload: conversational customer-support assistant (24/7).
- Estimated monthly tokens: 150M to 250M tokens/month (avg 200M).
- Peak concurrency: modest, bursty (100–250 rps for short windows).
- Desired SLA: 99.9% latency SLO for p95 token time.

Pricing & unit economics discussed:
- Target $/1M tokens range you mentioned: $20–$35 per 1M tokens depending on committed volumes and reserved capacity.
- We outlined two options: Hosted API consumption (variable) vs. Dedicated Reserved pool (committed, lower $/token).

Action items / asks:
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly token volume band (150–200M or 200–250M) so I can model the unit economics?
2) Please confirm the economic buyer and who will own the budget approval (finance contact) — you mentioned a finance review next week.
3) Any procurement requirements (PO process, SSO, SOC2 evidence) so we can loop in our ops team.

Attachments: I attached a preliminary pricing estimate workbook (redwood-pricing-estimate-acme-ai.xlsx) with a simple model for $/1M tokens under hosted vs dedicated.

Next steps: once we have the volume band and budget owner, I will share a versioned estimate and draft SOW to route for finance sign-off.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate-acme-ai.xlsx (Excel workbook, pricing model)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-ai.com>

Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up & stakeholder alignment — token volumes & budget (Acme AI)

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap.

Confirming:
- Estimated monthly tokens: leaning toward 200–240M/month in steady state. We expect a pilot month to be ~120M then ramp to ~220M over three months.
- Target unit economics: finance would like to see scenarios at $20, $25, and $30 per 1M tokens with committed discounts at 6–12 month terms.

Economic buyer and budget owner:
- Economic buyer: Claire Simmons, VP Finance (cc'd to procurement in a sec).
- Budget owner: Product (my manager), but finance approval is required for any committed spend over $75k/month.

Procurement: I'll have procurement loop in any PO/contract needs — they prefer to see a draft SOW + estimate.

Can you send a versioned estimate reflecting the three unit prices and a 6- vs 12-month reserved capacity discount?

Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of AI Products, Acme AI
alex.johnson@acme-ai.com

Appreciate the clarity, Alex — that's exactly what we needed. Quick notes:

1) I'll prepare three scenarios (flat hosted pricing at $30/1M, mid at $25/1M reserved 6-month, and $20/1M reserved 12-month) and include estimated monthly cost for the token bands you quoted (120M pilot / 200M steady / 220–240M ramp).
2) Rishi — can you confirm whether the Dedicated reserved pool can hit $20/1M at the 12-month commit for ~220–240M sustained tokens? Also include any setup/overhead costs we should show to Acme.
3) Aditya — can you prepare a short SOW template we can send to procurement (one-pager + DocuSign link). I attached a draft SOW for reference (SOW-draft-acme-ai.pdf).

I'll push the estimate and SOW draft by EOD tomorrow once Rishi confirms the reserved pricing.

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa / Aditya — quick pricing confirmation from infra side:

- Dedicated reserved 12-month commit: we can offer $19.50 per 1M tokens effective for token consumption above the reserved threshold (we'll model with breakpoints). This includes standard support; premium SLA add-on is extra.
- Dedicated reserved 6-month commit: $23.00 per 1M tokens.
- Hosted API (no commit): modeled at $32–35 per 1M tokens depending on sustained throughput and caching efficiency.
- Setup fee: one-time $6,000 for onboarding, unless the customer needs custom infra (then TBD).

I'll include a simple cost table and estimated monthly totals for 120/200/240M bands and will pass to Marissa by 11:30 AM PT.

Rishi
Head of Dedicated Solutions, Redwood Inference
